source.label: Official Hong Kong residential statistics

metricDefinitions.label: YoY / MoM
metricDefinitions.definition: Change against the exact same month one year earlier / the previous month. Missing comparator months remain blank.

metricDefinitions.label: Price and rental indices
metricDefinitions.definition: RVD private residential indices, 1999=100. Sale-price statistics exclude primary residential sales.

metricDefinitions.label: Mortgage lending rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Explicit observation months reported in HKMA half-yearly reports. No interpolation or forward filling.

metricDefinitions.label: Average residential price per square foot
metricDefinitions.definition: RVD table 1.2 by saleable-area class A–E and district. HKD per square foot = official HKD per square metre × 0.09290304. Original values, units and flags are retained. Excludes primary residential sales. No averaging across districts or across months.

caveats: P = provisional. Z = fewer than 20 cases.
Averages are sensitive to transaction mix; statistical market yield is not property-specific net yield.
Sales are counted by registration month, which may lag the agreement date.

evidenceFlow.title: Refresh pipeline
evidenceFlow.detail: updater/refresh.py retrieves RVD CSV and the rolling monthly PDF, Land Registry JSON and HKMA API / half-yearly reports. Source-specific fallback, unique-key checks and revision logs are retained.

source.label: RVD residential report tables
caveats: Annual, quarterly, monthly, year-to-date and forecast observations are separate and must not be summed.
